title: Dependent Parents in an Opening Past-Due Release of Disability Compensation
content:
The parent additions in the opening past-due release of a Disability Compensation award are as many parent additions as the parent maximum of 2 when the award records at least 2 dependent parents, one parent addition when it records exactly one dependent parent, and nothing when it records none.

Dependent parents recorded are the parent additions on the award less the parent removals. Each parent addition is counted for the whole months elapsed from the most recent parent addition's effective date to the issue date of the most recent monthly payment; of those months, as many as fall in the months owed at the individual unemployability rate — never more than the parent months — take the 100 percent tier's parent addition of 176.88, and the rest take the award's own tier.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating); latest parent addition effective 1 December 2025; most recent monthly payment issued 1 April 2026: 4 whole months; no months at the individual unemployability rate)**

| Dependent parents recorded | Parent additions | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | None | Nothing |
| 1 | One, for 4 months | 88.44 for 4 months, 353.76 |
| 2 | Two, for 4 months | 707.52 |
| 3 | Two (the maximum), for 4 months | 707.52 |
